verdict.rationale: Superset advertises being local-first (code never leaves your machine), offers a standalone CLI binary that drives a 'local host server' and can be used from CI, and includes a paid 'Remote access' tier — all suggesting it can be self-hosted outside the desktop GUI. However, there is no explicit documentation of container/Docker deployment or running on a VM/server headlessly, and community evidence notes it's built on Electron with macOS-first support (no Windows build), raising doubts about broader self-hosted infrastructure flexibility.  Missing for 10: explicit container/Docker deployment instructions, documented VM/server headless setup, and cross-platform (Linux/Windows) self-hosting confirmation.
